texts.zh:
我们在[Root.GetName]发现了一种极为恶心的本土生物。

它们进化出了一种防御机制，同时也成为了它们获取食物的主要方式。由于缺乏自身分解固体食物所需的消化酶，它们会释放出一种强烈且令人作呕的气体，当其他具有正常消化系统的生物吸入时，会引发剧烈呕吐。这些被排出的物质随后被它们作为主要的营养来源。

清除这些令人厌恶的生物将为我们带来丰厚的异星天然气和食物资源。
texts.en:
We have encountered a notably disgusting species of fauna native to [Root.GetName].

They have evolved a defense mechanism that happens to also serve as their primary method of food acquisition. Lacking the digestive enzymes needed to break down solid food on their own, they emit a powerful and repulsive gas that induces projectile vomiting when inhaled by other organisms with a functioning gut. These ejected substances are then consumed as their main source of nutrients.

The culling of these foul creatures will provide a useful windfall of Exotic Gas and Food.

texts.zh:
我们在[Root.GetName]的[Owner.GetColonistPlural]遇到了一种本土的动物物种，它们拥有一种相当……独特的获取食物的方式。

尽管最初这些生物较为害羞，但它们已经逐渐习惯了我们的存在，并且由于其友好的天性，甚至在一些较为幼稚的[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]中颇受欢迎。

虽然它们不构成直接威胁，但它们进化出了一种防御机制，这种机制恰好也是它们获取食物的主要方式。由于缺乏自身分解固体食物所需的消化酶，它们会释放出一种强烈且令人作呕的气体，当被其他具有正常消化系统的生物吸入时，会引发剧烈的呕吐。这些被排出的物质随后被它们作为主要的营养来源。

总的来说，这一情况存在传染病蔓延的风险，当地领导人一直在敦促[Owner.GetColonistPlural]远离这些奇怪的生物。
texts.en:
Our [Owner.GetColonistPlural] on [Root.GetName] have encountered a species of fauna native to the planet with a rather... unique method of gathering its food.

Though initially shy, these creatures have since become accustomed to our presence, and with their friendly nature are even proving popular among the more immature [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

While posing no direct danger, they have evolved a defense mechanism that happens to also serve as their primary method of food acquisition. Lacking the digestive enzymes needed to break down solid food on their own, they emit a powerful and repulsive gas that induces projectile vomiting when inhaled by other organisms with a functioning gut. These ejected substances are then consumed as their main source of nutrients.

The overall situation has a risk of spreading infectious diseases, and local leaders have been urging [Owner.GetColonistPlural] to steer clear of the strange things.

label.zh: 多么奇葩的异种生物学知识。

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of this planet appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这个物种的名称。
note.en: In the game, the species' name appears here.

texts.zh:
清除[Root.GetName]上令人作呕的害虫已被证明十分困难。尽管官方已发出警告，但殖民地中较为年轻的成员仍然继续与这些动物玩耍。

由于这个原因，我们的[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesOrganName]蛋白质已经成为它们首选的食物来源。与行星上其他知道躲避它们恶臭气体的动物相比，我们的殖民地已经变得更容易被攻击。这些生物已经进一步适应了我们的存在，并且有人目击到它们对任何饭后独自游荡的[Owner.GetColonist]采取伏击战术。

令人难以置信的是，这种情况也有一些好处。我们的科学家发现，这些生物排放的催吐气体中含有宝贵的异星天然气粒子，可以通过驯养这些野兽并将它们圈养在隔离设施中来收集。

然而，大多数殖民者都提议我们直接根除它们。
texts.en:
Ridding [Root.GetName] of its revolting pests has proven difficult. Younger members of the colony continue to play with the animals despite official warnings.

As a result of this, our [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesOrganName] proteins have become their preferred source of food. Our colony has become a much easier target than the rest of the planetary fauna who know to avoid their foul gases. These creatures have adapted further to our presence, and have been witnessed employing ambush tactics against any lone [Owner.GetColonist] wandering around after a meal.

Unbelievably, there are some benefits to this situation. Our scientists have discovered the emetic fumes emitted by the creatures contain valuable Exotic Gas particles which could be harvested by domesticating the beasts and keeping them in quarantined facilities.

The majority of the colony, however, have proposed that we simply eradicate them.

label.en: Enough is enough. Shoot them on sight.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现我们物种相关的器官名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the species' organ type appears here.

texts.zh:
[Root.GetName]上的生物不再引发大规模呕吐现象。

随着针对其异种生物学构造的合成营养膏的研发，我们已调节了它们的饮食周期，彻底根除了它们对我们[Owner.GetColonistPlural]的偷袭。

我们已将它们迁移至一个精心设计的野生动物保护区，公众可以在安全的环境中观赏这些动物。专业饲养员已接受培训，能够在不造成进一步伤害的情况下提取它们的异星天然气。
texts.en:
The creatures on [Root.GetName] are no longer causing mass regurgitations.

With the development of a synthetic nutrient paste catered to their xenobiology, we have regulated their dietary cycles and put an end to their opportunistic ambushes on our [Owner.GetColonistPlural].

We have relocated them to a carefully designed wildlife reserve where the public can enjoy the animals in a safe environment. Specialist handlers have been trained to extract their Exotic Gas without further harm.

label.zh: 确保我们不会发展出那种气味。
label.en: Ensure that we don't evolve that smell.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of this planet appears here.

texts.zh:
自从采纳官方的“就地射杀”政策以来，已经过去几个月了，再也没有人在[Root.GetName]殖民地附近发现过那些惹人厌的物种。

虽然有些[Owner.GetColonistPlural]怀念这些毛茸茸的生物，但现在每个人都更快乐了，因为他们可以自由行动，不必再担心被强制呕吐。

我们的科学家已经收集了这些动物的尸体，直接从它们的内脏中提取了一些异星天然气。
texts.en:
Since adopting an official shoot on sight policy, it has now been several months since the offending species on [Root.GetName] was last sighted near the colony.

While some [Owner.GetColonistPlural] miss the presence of the furry creatures, everyone is happier overall now that they can travel freely without fear of forcibly regurgitating.

Our scientists have harvested the bodies of the animals, extracting some amount of Exotic Gas directly from their internal organs.

label.zh: 确保我们不会发展出那种气味。
label.en: Ensure that we don't evolve that smell.

# 恶心虫虫 / Revolting Pests

- 分类 Category: C8 银河轶事 / C8 Galactic miscellany · 来源 Sources: events/strange_worlds_events.txt:1846-2165; common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:3734 on_colony_1_year_old (random 20/510) · DLC: BioGenesis · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13

## 如何开始 How it starts

殖民地满1年时随机事件池以20/510抽中 strange_worlds.150（common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:3734），机器帝国除外；360天后 strange_worlds.155。触发前提：BioGenesis DLC，人类玩家的非首都、非母星、仍由原建立者持有的人造以外殖民星球，没有地面战斗，也未被占领；并且该殖民地尚未触发过其他“奇异世界”事件（colony_event 旗标），每个国家每条故事只触发一次。

A colony turning 1 year old can draw strange_worlds.150 (20/510, common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:3734), machine empires excluded; strange_worlds.155 follows after 360 days. Preconditions: BioGenesis DLC, a human player's non-capital, non-homeworld, original-owner, non-artificial colony without ground combat or occupation, which has not yet had another Strange Worlds event (colony_event flag); once per country per chain.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

strange_worlds.155“恶心虫虫”：a“独特的异种生物学”——180天后 strange_worlds.160“令人作呕的进展”：a“把它们围起来”——180天后 strange_worlds.165“清新空气”；b“格杀勿论”——360天后 strange_worlds.170“下令格杀”。净化者的专属选项（b_purifiers）直接通向 strange_worlds.170。

strange_worlds.155 "Revolting Pests": a "What unique xenobiology" - 180 days later strange_worlds.160 "Disgusting Developments": a "Wrangle them up" - 180 days later strange_worlds.165 "A Breath of Fresh Air"; b "Shoot them on sight" - 360 days later strange_worlds.170 "Shoot to Kill". The purifier-only option (b_purifiers) leads straight to strange_worlds.170.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

165 与 170 互斥。

165 and 170 are exclusive.
